The 9353-pair deterministic Morse matching is acyclic on every nonempty face-poset cover, leaving one zero-cell, six four-cells, eight five-cells. The exact signed 6×8 Morse differential matches the submitted matrix and has rank five with a determinant-one 5×5 minor, yielding S4∨3S5 by integral elementary cell cancellation. Independent orbit-enumeration computes all 96 D8×S3 signed reduced Lefschetz traces and matches the proposed degree-separated characters; the rank-one H4 candidate/norm argument identifies the modules rationally. The calculation is for this single graph, not all cycle lengths.
